name: What is a site plan, and why is it required?

mainEntity.name: What is a site plan, and why is it required?

acceptedAnswer.text: A site plan shows property lines, building placement, setbacks, access, utilities, and grading to confirm the project fits zoning rules and site conditions before permitting.
